description: This file defines several classes and functions related to logging within the TestLink project. It includes classes for different logging mechanisms such as database logging, file logging, email notifications, and transaction management. The code also sets up error handling for PHP errors to be logged appropriately and initializes a global logger instance upon include.

classes.name: tlLogger
classes.description: Main logging class that manages different types of loggers, log levels, and transaction control. Provides static create method to instantiate singleton logger instance.

classes.name: tlTransaction
classes.description: Represents a logging transaction, possibly encompassing multiple log events, with methods to initialize, close, and manage the transaction lifecycle.

classes.name: tlEvent
classes.description: Represents a single log event with properties like log level, description, timestamp, associated transaction, and methods for database operations.

classes.name: tlEventManager
classes.description: Handles retrieval and deletion of logged events from the database, with singleton pattern to ensure a single instance.

classes.name: tlDBLogger
classes.description: Logs events and transactions directly into a database.

classes.name: tlFileLogger
classes.description: Logs events and transactions to a file on disk.

classes.name: tlMailLogger
classes.description: Sends log events via email, configured with administrative email addresses.

methods.name: watchPHPErrors
methods.description: Custom PHP error handler that logs specified PHP errors into the TestLink logging system.

methods.name: shutdownLogger
methods.description: Shutdown function registered with PHP that ensures the current transaction is properly closed when the script terminates.
